newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Japan blocks WTO panel in Fuji-Kodak dispute.
newsitem.headline: Japan blocks WTO panel in Fuji-Kodak dispute.

text.p: Japan on Thursday blocked the immediate creation of a World Trade Organisation panel to look into the Fuji Photo Film Co /Eastman Kodak dispute over access to Japan's photo-film market, trade diplomats said.
But creation of the panel, which will have six months to return its findings, will be automatic at the next meeting of the WTO's Dispute Settlement Body on October 16.
